entities.name: Francisco Fábregas Monegal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco ("Kiko") Fábregas Monegal is a field hockey midfielder from Spain, who finished in fourth position with the Men's National Team at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece. Four years earlier, in Sydney, he ended up in ninth place with the national side. Fábregas plays club hockey for Real Club de Polo in his hometown of Barcelona.
